description.zh: 调用 DeepSeek 官方全新独立搜索接口（`/v1/tools/search`），**按次计费，不消耗模型 Token**。返回结构化来源（含权威度分级 authority / 相关度得分 rerank_score / 站点名与发布日期）。**需自备 Key**：优先读 Operit 环境变量 `DEEPSEEK_API_KEY`，其次读 `/root/.deepseek_native_search_key`。未配置时返回明确错误与接入指引，不伪造结果。
description.en: Call DeepSeek's official standalone Search API (`/v1/tools/search`): **billed per call, no model tokens consumed**. Returns structured sources with authority tier, rerank score, site name and publish date. **Bring your own key**: Operit env var `DEEPSEEK_API_KEY` first, then `/root/.deepseek_native_search_key`. Without a key the tool returns a clear error with setup instructions — it never fabricates results.
description.default: DeepSeek official standalone Search API (/v1/tools/search). Billed per call, no model tokens consumed. Returns structured sources with authority tier. Bring your own DEEPSEEK_API_KEY.

description.zh: 调用 DeepSeek 官方独立搜索接口（/v1/tools/search），按次计费，不消耗模型 Token。返回结构化来源（支持权威度分级）。需自备 Key（DEEPSEEK_API_KEY）。
description.en: DeepSeek official standalone Search API (/v1/tools/search). Billed per call, no model tokens consumed. Returns structured sources with authority tiers. Bring your own DEEPSEEK_API_KEY.
